goal: Make root skill/ the sole standard Skill authoring and competition submission source, with actual SDK consumption.
changes: Move four domain procedures to skill/<name>/SKILL.md with standard YAML name/description and ordinary Markdown; all 254 original guidance fields preserved, no embedded author JSON.
Discover added standard packages dynamically, reuse locked Deep Agents parsing and middleware, bridge exact text into the existing approved knowledge path instead of adding another author schema.

Read main bodies and adjacent UTF-8 text on demand through read_skill; freeze reference/script/assets paths and original bytes. Empty support files accepted, non-text/NUL, path escape and changed saved resources rejected.
Support explicit metadata.dfx-load=always in the standard metadata map; default remains on-demand. Only complete main bodies are injected, actual request/budget and existing capacity limits apply.
Keep legacy renderer, tool definition and saved profile semantics; separate resource reads from full-body actions and context deduplication. Author edits/removal do not replace old task originals.

Archive former resources/skills JSON locally with the original relative layout; remove live source dependencies and Git tracking. Update current document owners and remove a stale duplicate PowerShell deployment row.

validation.scope: Grouped software validation. Early SDK/resource/competition groups preceded the additive empty-support-file extension, covered by the package suite; later legacy/report suites ran after that extension. Import grouping/lint comments changed no execution behavior. The production Skill suite was repeated after final import formatting and Skill EOF whitespace normalization.

failed_attempts.reason: Two Windows fixture LF expectations conflicted with exact CRLF originals; fixed expectations/fixture bytes without normalizing runtime text.
New test assumed wire tool messages include name; read actual role/result instead.
Whole-tree mtime comparison included routinely refreshed agent-report; use immutable source/ledger bytes and zero-turn counters.
Metadata before-validator changed strict JSON list/tuple admission; replaced ambiguous metadata union with native shape plus explicit legacy validation.
Report refresh changes per-turn counters; verify frozen originals/ledgers and actual costs rather than asserting an unchanged transient report.
Two import groups and TRY004 for a document-validation ValueError; formatting and explanatory lint comment only.

audit.standard: https://agentskills.io/specification (consulted 2026-10-14); metadata.dfx-load is our explicit host extension, not a universal standard field.
audit.review: Independent read-only review identified the standard/legacy annotation overlap and verified key legacy interfaces; final corrections checked by root and software suites. A later optional reviewer follow-up was unavailable due usage limit, so no independent final-code signoff claimed.
audit.premises: Standard Markdown stays free of a private heading schema. Detailed prerequisites remain in original text; the internal structured applicability bridge has one generic prerequisite, not automatic extraction of prior typed premise IDs.
audit.retrieval: Native catalog/read_skill path is progressive. Ordinary experience retrieval preserves the complete projection and can return all package text.
audit.resource_limit: Current package admission/reading supports UTF-8 text; binary attachments require separate capability admission. Bundled scripts and allowed-tools declarations do not grant execution.
audit.application_limit: Local toolchain/device/signing and independently bound checks/oracles remain P2 work; synthetic checks do not establish application repair or paper contribution.

next: P2 accept local application execution and provider/budget/data-call scope; then a small real baseline/enhanced comparison. No expansion of runtime or automatic Skill evolution.
